items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: I used to know her well.

ctx.x: ( ?). Some family like that. I think it was (Guggenheim?). They have a lot of money. I used to know her well. Alice, I think... ?). So Benny Goodman, from my experience, is nothing much.

Well this is I think what the values of this kind of, I don't think you can call it an interview because I'm having a marvellous time just sitting here talking to you. (LAUGHTER). But we need the insights that other people have.
